summary: Reproduced the chunked-prefill request-slot double count in the checked-out Scheduler: with 14 decoding requests, one in-flight chunk holding a pool row, one free pool row, and a ceiling of 16, the baseline marks the batch full and leaves the queued request unissued. The fix credits the held row only when that chunk is actually appended to the current prefill batch, including the PD-prefill gate, while preserving PP, Hybrid-SWA, pending-beam-row, and beam-width limits.
